realms.name: The Verdant Beginning
realms.desc: A lonely floating island of lush forests, quiet streams and ancient trees — where every great kingdom starts.

realms.name: Crystal Hollow
realms.desc: Caverns beneath the roots, lit by living crystal. Glowing creatures drift through the dark.

realms.name: The Skylands
realms.desc: Floating islands strung together by bridges of cloud, turning on the high winds.

realms.name: The Forgotten Wilds
realms.desc: An enchanted forest gone wild with glowing mushrooms, rare blooms and half-remembered spirits.

realms.name: Frostfall
realms.desc: Frozen lakes and snow-heavy pines around a palace of ancient ice.

realms.name: The Astral Realm
realms.desc: Celestial islands adrift in the cosmic ocean, crowned with observatories of star and glass.

realms.name: The First Kingdom
realms.desc: The origin of the Blocklings and the Heart Tree — a civilization the world forgot it ever was.
